title: prunella vulgaris subsp. grandiflora
intro: Prunella vulgaris subsp. grandiflora, commonly known as the large-flowered self-heal, is a subspecies of the Prunella vulgaris plant, a perennial herb native to Europe and Asia. It is valued for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Prunella vulgaris subsp. grandiflora include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of colds, fever, and respiratory infections. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to stimulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit sedative and antispasmodic effects, while its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids.
